sentences.en: We are constrained to and restrained from an action.
sentences.zh: 我们被迫采取行动，也被限制不采取某些行动。

sentences.en: The government finances are severely constrained because of falling tax revenues.
sentences.zh: 由于税收收入下降，政府的财政状况受到了严重制约。

sentences.en: What human trespass would constrain thy power, O Zeus?
sentences.zh: 你的权力，哦宙斯，会被人类的任何侵犯所限制吗？

senses.zh: 限制：restriction；使人屈服于（压力、感情）等：
